actualization_cost.best_method: resource-constrained protocol optimization with reversible constructions before calorimetry
actualization_cost.cheap_kill: reversible implementation and complete ordinary resource accounting eliminate the residual
actualization_cost.first_decisive_assay: matched reversible reconciliation protocols with a complete resource ledger and calorimetric upper bound
actualization_cost.promotion_condition: strict residual lower bound depends on certified distinctions after equal capability and all ordinary resources are matched
actualization_cost.scale_condition: an encoding-invariant lower bound predicts a cross-platform ratio without refitting
actualization_cost.standard_absorber: Landauer erasure, measurement work, blank archives, authentication, communication, coherence, and latency

capability_backreaction.best_method: derive a causal/Hamiltonian no-coupling theorem and an explicit capability-sourced interaction before apparatus
capability_backreaction.cheap_kill: any coupling, leakage, controller-state change, or observer-boundary refit explains the effect
capability_backreaction.first_decisive_assay: randomized physically present but isolated recovery hardware with identical system channels and leakage bounds
capability_backreaction.promotion_condition: unused capability changes outcomes despite an experimentally null interaction channel
capability_backreaction.scale_condition: a nonzero law is explicit, no-signalling-safe, and not a disguised apparatus interaction
capability_backreaction.standard_absorber: stray controller coupling, changed boundary, changed tester, or ordinary closed-loop feedback

finality_memory_residual.best_method: randomized pre-break history, replacement causal break, nested memory-boundary expansion, and all-port tomography
finality_memory_residual.cheap_kill: the residual vanishes after one omitted memory or route register is reset, or the complete process predicts it
finality_memory_residual.first_decisive_assay: causal break plus system-and-memory re-preparation followed by the same Bell-correlation tester
finality_memory_residual.promotion_condition: residual survives expanding memory completion and a frozen implementation-complete quantum-process null
finality_memory_residual.scale_condition: survives nested memory completion, leakage bounds, no-signalling, and a frozen effect-size estimator
finality_memory_residual.standard_absorber: retained environment, controller, route, or classical history register represented in a process tensor

graph_threshold_actualization.best_method: process-equivalent graph pairs where possible, plus matched up/down sweeps, exact uncomputation, and held-out finite-size scaling against graph-dependent quantum rivals
graph_threshold_actualization.cheap_kill: retained labels, ordinary graph-dependent dynamics, decoherence, known criticality, or node-count convention explains the curves
graph_threshold_actualization.first_decisive_assay: an invariant graph term predicts a residual beyond the calibrated routed quantum process, ideally between process-equivalent implementations
graph_threshold_actualization.promotion_condition: finite-size scaling or hysteresis remains after the complete channel, history register, and resource model predicts zero
graph_threshold_actualization.scale_condition: one order parameter and scaling relation predicts held-out sizes without platform-specific redefinition
graph_threshold_actualization.standard_absorber: classical threshold logic, finite memory, ordinary decoherence, QEC, or a thermodynamic critical family

reconciliation_curvature.best_method: quantum-comb or groupoid formulation, routed process tomography, vertex-gauge quotient, orientation reversal, and benign subdivision
reconciliation_curvature.cheap_kill: the route register, ordinary gate sequence, clock mismatch, or known geometric phase predicts the loop result
reconciliation_curvature.first_decisive_assay: three-recorder closed loop with routed process tomography, vertex-gauge changes, and benign subdivision controls
reconciliation_curvature.promotion_condition: gauge- and refinement-invariant residue survives the implementation-complete routed process
reconciliation_curvature.scale_condition: the residue composes under loop concatenation and remains gauge- and refinement-invariant
reconciliation_curvature.standard_absorber: route register, noncommuting operation order, process memory, reference-frame transformation, or geometric phase

record_sourced_geometry.best_method: derive a local covariantly conserved, refinement-invariant source tensor with units before designing an apparatus
record_sourced_geometry.cheap_kill: the source is nonconserved, observer/basis dependent, subdivision sensitive, or ordinary stress-energy
record_sourced_geometry.first_decisive_assay: derive a covariantly conserved source before any apparatus proposal; then match stress-energy in a mesoscopic control
record_sourced_geometry.promotion_condition: conserved nonzero signal remains after standard gravitational and open-system sources are matched
record_sourced_geometry.scale_condition: the theory closes and gives a coefficient range not already excluded before a matched-stress-energy experiment
record_sourced_geometry.standard_absorber: stress-energy, entropy redistribution, control fields, ordinary decoherence, and representation-dependent record count

causal_break_memory_control.declared_ab_state_after_break: same Bell state for both histories
causal_break_memory_control.genuine_extension_requirement: repeatable residual after re-preparing the system and every admitted quantum/classical memory and after an implementation-complete multi-time process null

claim_grade: ANALYTIC FINITE STANDARD-QUANTUM ABSORPTION CONTROL / DETERMINISTIC NUMERICAL FIXTURE / CONDITIONAL EXTENSION REGISTRY / NO NEW-PHYSICS CLAIM
does_not_establish: exhaustion of every standard quantum completion

consequences: finite threshold, hysteresis, provenance, and route-label effects are not by themselves beyond quantum theory
a residual after a system-only reset first witnesses an incomplete memory boundary, not a new law
a genuinely beyond-standard claim must survive an implementation-complete causal break or explicitly change the linear quantum dynamics
naive preparation-context nonlinear dynamics can violate no-signalling and therefore fails the entanglement gate
finite_absorption_boundary.novelty_grade: KNOWN CONTROLLED-CHANNEL/STINESPRING/PROCESS-MEMORY TERRAIN; USEFUL DU PROGRAM BOUNDARY
finite_absorption_boundary.statement: A finite classical history/finality label and a label-conditioned family of linear CPTP maps form an ordinary classical-quantum controlled process on an enlarged state.

no_broadcasting_control.scope: orthogonal pointer labels may be copied; an arbitrary noncommuting quantum state may not

nonlinear_no_signalling_control.scope_warning: this finite counterexample does not rule out every carefully constructed stochastic or global nonlinear theory
